# Recommended GitHub labels

Create these in **Settings → Labels** (colors are suggestions):

| Label | Purpose |
|-------|---------|
| `phase-1` | Production foundation (tooling, CI, seed URLs) |
| `phase-2` | Run structure (modes, pause, persistence) |
| `phase-3` | Gameplay depth (archetypes, cargo/vehicle presets) |
| `phase-4` | Simulation & performance (replay, worker, adaptive fluid) |
| `phase-5` | Presentation & audio (settings, SFX, quality tiers) |
| `phase-6` | Meta & community (optional online features) |
| `phase-7` | Isometric framing (lookahead, diamond cull, golden frame) |
| `phase-8` | Road grades and the liquid’s response |
| `phase-9` | Next-bend read, slosh meter, gamepad |
| `phase-10` | Banking, ramps, dry washes |
| `phase-11` | Wheel spin, body pitch, impact thud |
| `phase-12` | Pickup, props, and the layered mix on the graded truck |
| `phase-13` | Visible bank, grade crease, contact shadows |
| `phase-14` | Ink grain freeze and a liquid specular that survives cel |
| `phase-15` | One mix: layers, decaying scrub, thud, lip accent |
| `phase-16` | Cargo voice and a spill that reads as liquid |
| `phase-17` | Short-wheelbase axles on the drawn truck |
| `phase-18` | Grade and airborne reads, hints, and results |
| `phase-19` | Difficulty scales the hill; medium stays put |
| `phase-20` | Airborne mix: no rumble, no throttle load |
| `phase-21` | Spring-damper visual pitch settle |
| `phase-22` | Particle and skid fade curves |
| `phase-23` | Master volume, soft mute, pause duck |
| `phase-24` | Desert wind bed and material impacts |
| `phase-25` | Chase ease and slosh-meter hysteresis |
| `bug` | Incorrect behavior |
| `feature` | New player-facing capability |
| `physics/rendering` | Simulation or graphics pipeline |
